themes.label: Paratext, Edition History, and Textual Apparatus
themes.rationale: Encompasses the bibliographic front matter, editorial acknowledgments, revision history, and transcriber collation notes of the Jowett edition.

themes.label: The Nature of Justice and the Challenge to Morality
themes.rationale: Focuses on the opening definitions of justice, Thrasymachus's might-makes-right thesis, the social contract challenge, and the central mandate to prove justice desirable in itself.

themes.label: Genesis and Architecture of the Just State and Soul
themes.rationale: Covers the foundation of the state through division of labor, the tripartite psychology of the individual soul, the four cardinal virtues, and the definition of justice as internal and civic order.

themes.label: The Communal Ideal, Guardianship, and Paradoxical Reforms
themes.rationale: Addresses the radical social arrangements of the guardians, including the community of goods and family, female guardian equality, civic brotherhood, and the synthesis of Spartan-Athenian customs.

themes.label: Philosopher-Kings, Higher Metaphysics, and Epistemic Ascent
themes.rationale: Details the paradox of philosopher-kings, the sun and line analogies, the cave allegory, dialectic, mathematical curriculum, and the Idea of the Good.

themes.label: Constitutional Degeneration and the Tyrannical Soul
themes.rationale: Traces the sequential degradation of governments and corresponding human characters from timocracy to tyranny, culminating in proofs of the tyrant's supreme misery.

themes.label: Education, Aesthetics, Immortality, and Comparative Reception
themes.rationale: Explores the curriculum of music and gymnastics, the theological and mimetic censorship of poetry, the immortality of the soul and the Myth of Er, and broader comparative utopian philosophy.
